summary: The article accurately reports on American Express's Q2 2026 earnings, including revenue, billed business, and the market's reaction to rising costs. The claims are consistent with multiple financial news outlets and American Express's investor relations.

claims.claim: American Express reported a 10% increase in quarterly revenue, reaching $19.6 billion.
claims.note: American Express reported Q2 2026 revenue of $19.6 billion, a 10% increase year-over-year.

claims.claim: Total card spending, or billed business, grew 9% year-over-year to $455.8 billion on an FX-adjusted basis.
claims.note: Billed business increased 9% year-over-year to $455.8 billion on an FX-adjusted basis in Q2 2026.

claims.claim: Despite robust earnings and a higher revenue outlook, American Express shares experienced a tumble.
claims.note: American Express shares fell despite beating profit estimates and raising its full-year revenue forecast for 2026.

claims.claim: The decline in share price was primarily attributed to concerns over rising costs impacting investor sentiment.
claims.note: Investors focused on rising expenses and higher spending on customer acquisition, leading to the share price decline.

claims.claim: American Express said second-quarter expenses increased 12% to $14.5 billion, compared with $12.9 billion a year ago.
claims.note: Consolidated expenses for Q2 2026 were $14.5 billion, a 12% increase from $12.9 billion in the prior year.

claims.claim: American Express lifted its full-year revenue growth forecast to 10%, up from its earlier guidance of 9% to 10%.
claims.note: American Express raised its full-year 2026 revenue growth forecast to 10% from the previous 9% to 10%.

claims.claim: For the quarter ended June 30, American Express reported earnings of $4.53 per share, compared with $4.08 per share a year earlier, comfortably beating analysts' average estimate of $4.40 per share.
claims.note: American Express reported Q2 2026 earnings of $4.53 per share, up from $4.08 a year prior, exceeding analyst estimates of $4.40.
